Rina (Billing): FYI: several customers received duplicate invoices for billing-period 2026-04 because tax lines were recalculated twice after a timezone shift during the nightly job. Customers: Northline, Pelago, and Emberware.
Tom B: what caused the double-calc? any logs?
Rina (Billing): billing-bot flagged tax_recalc_race then renderer proceeded. Logs:
```
2026-04-10T02:00:01Z INFO tax_service: recalc_start batch=apr-10 tz=UTC->America/Los_Angeles job=tax-recalc-8
2026-04-10T02:00:02Z ERROR tax_service: tax_recalc_race invoice=0xd9a attempt=1 detail=partial_write
2026-04-10T02:00:03Z INFO tax_service: retry attempt=2 invoice=0xd9a tax_total_cents=4500 applied=true
2026-04-10T02:00:04Z INFO invoices: pdf_rendered invoice=0xd9a pdf=pdf_d9a_v1
2026-04-10T02:00:05Z INFO tax_service: late_patch invoice=0xd9a tax_total_cents=4500 applied=true duplicate=true
2026-04-10T02:00:06Z INFO invoices: pdf_rendered invoice=0xd9a pdf=pdf_d9a_v2
```
Jules: So renderer allowed a second PDF after the late_patch even though one already existed. That produced duplicate invoice numbers for some customers.
Billing Bot: ALERT: invoice_generation duplicate_pdf_detected count=3 batch=apr-10 job=tax-recalc-8
Olivia (Finance): Customer-visible impact: duplicate invoice numbers and overstated totals (tax duplicated). We need remediation. Options? retract duplicates and issue corrected invoices with a note, or issue credit memos?
Tom B: Recommended flow:
- freeze outgoing invoice emails for this batch immediately
- run consistency query: list invoices where pdf_count > 1 OR tax_line_count > 1
- for each customer, if duplicate leads to overcharge > $1, create credit note + corrected invoice; if only duplicate PDF number but totals identical, quietly replace PDFs
Rina (Billing): SQL to enumerate (staging first):
```
SELECT i.id, i.customer, array_agg(i.pdf_id) as pdfs, count(t.*) as tax_lines, i.total_cents
FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN invoice_lines t ON t.invoice_id=i.id AND t.type='tax'
WHERE i.batch='apr-10'
GROUP BY i.id, i.customer, i.total_cents
HAVING count(t.*)>1 OR count(i.pdf_id)>1;
```
Olivia (Finance): I approve credits up to $250 for impacted customers for this incident. Note text: "System correction: duplicate tax line caused by timezone retry."
Jules: I'll add a guard to disallow renderer from producing pdf if pdf_exists=true OR finalize_committed=false. Also adding idempotency token to tax_recalc calls.
QA Bot: Smoke tests added to nightly to simulate timezone shift and assert single tax_line per invoice.
Rina (Billing): Opening ticket FIN-4492, tagging @Olivia (Finance) and @Jules for patch. Will run the consistency query in 10m and post results.
Tom B: Good. prioritize Northline and Pelago for manual outreach if credit > $50.
Olivia (Finance): thanks team. keep replies terse while we sweep. :white_check_mark:
